author: Kirstine Beck

materials: Laboratory protocol Smallpox Vaccination and CCR5 expression
Extract the liquid from the Falcon-tube
Must be mixed in chemical fume hood.

steps.title: Place tubes in LAF bench
steps.instruction: Place the Falcon tubes inside the laminar flow (LAF) bench.

steps.title: Add whole blood to tube
steps.instruction: Pipette exactly 70 µL of whole blood from the patient into each Falcon tube.

steps.title: Incubate blood on tilt-board
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 30 minutes on a tilt‑board placed inside a dark box.

steps.title: Prepare diluted BD Lysing Solution
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL BD Lysing Solution with 9 mL sterile water to obtain a 1:10 dilution (room temperature).

steps.title: Add Lysing Solution to blood
steps.instruction: Add 1.25 mL of the prepared BD Lysing Solution (room temperature) to the 70 µL blood (use 1 mL per 50 µL blood).

steps.title: Incubate lysed sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 20 minutes on a tilt‑board placed in a dark box.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 300 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in PBS
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) to the pellet and gently resuspend.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 300 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Leave 200 µL in tube
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant, leaving exactly 200 µL of liquid in the Falcon tube.

steps.title: Perform antibody compensation
steps.instruction: Before data acquisition, run an antibody compensation control as required for the flow cytometer.

steps.title: Acquire data on flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Run 400 µL of the prepared sample on the flow cytometer for analysis.

steps.title: Apply dilution correction factor
steps.instruction: Multiply the absolute cell count obtained by 1.2 to account for the Transfix dilution factor.

steps.title: Store Transfix tubes at 2–8 °C
steps.instruction: Keep the Transfix‑treated tubes at a temperature between 2 °C and 8 °C until analysis is complete.
